t: You're at Onslow Gardens, a garden square in the Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea. George Barber Paley, an English cleric, died here in 1880. He was born in 1799, so he reached about eighty-one. The material doesn't say where he served or what he was known for, so I can't tell you more about his ministry. What it does tell us is that a clergyman born at the very end of the eighteenth century ended his life on this square.
